text: This report is filed regarding suspicious activity in the account of Bilal Ali (CNIC 498431-5558559-5), a freelance software developer residing in Karachi. Between March 2 and March 11, 2026, the account received nine distinct inbound IBFT transfers totaling PKR 561,000 from multiple unrelated individuals, including Mehwish Tariq, Hina Tariq, Laiba Butt, and Sana Qadir. This pattern of numerous small-to-medium value deposits from diverse counterparties within a short 10-day window is inconsistent with the customer’s declared monthly income of PKR 90,000 and typical freelance payment structures. Following these deposits, the account exhibited rapid fund movement indicative of mule activity. On March 9, 2026, a large outbound transfer of PKR 235,000 was made to a QuickPay digital wallet (ending in 0932). Subsequently, on March 13, 2026, the customer withdrew PKR 159,000 in cash from an ATM in Islamabad, a city different from his declared residence. The combination of high-volume inbound transfers from multiple sources, immediate layering through digital wallets, and subsequent cash withdrawals in a different location strongly suggests the account is being used to launder illicit funds or facilitate border mule operations. No legitimate business rationale for this transactional behavior has been identified.
